description.narrative: This will be delivered through the Commonwealth Climate Finance Access Hub (CCFAH), established by the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM) in 2015 at Malta and began its operations in 2016 with the Central Hub located at Port Louis, Mauritius. Its purpose is to help Commonwealth member countries build their capacities to access climate finance to develop bankable mitigation, adaptation and cross-cutting projects in line with national climate priorities as envisaged under the Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) of the Paris Agreement, the National Adaptation Plans and other climate-related goals and commitments.
